scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @trading-os/shared && npm run build -w @trading-os/market-data && npm run build -w @trading-os/rule-engine && npm run build -w @trading-os/market-intelligence && npm run build -w @trading-os/database && npm run build -w @trading-os/engines && npm run build -w @trading-os/api && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @trading-os/shared && npm run build -w @trading-os/market-data && npm run build -w @trading-os/rule-engine && npm run build -w @trading-os/market-intelligence && npm run build -w @trading-os/database && npm run build -w @trading-os/engines
scripts.build:server: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @trading-os/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -b && npm run build -w @trading-os/api
